user.title: Dyness Open API
user.description: Enter the App ID and App Secret from the Dyness portal (Developer Center → API Management). Leave region on Auto-detect unless it fails.

devices.title: Choose devices
devices.description: Found {count} device(s) on {host}. Tick the ones to monitor. If your inverter is missing, type its serial number(s) below, separated by commas (the inverter S/N is on its side label).

error.invalid_auth: Dyness rejected the App ID / Secret on every region tried. Check them, or pick your region manually.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Dyness API.
error.no_devices: Select at least one device or enter a serial number.

abort.already_configured: This App ID is already set up.
